expectations.evidence: No tailwind.config.js created. Uses @variant dark in CSS.
Uses @variant dark with combined class + media query selector. Templates use dark: prefix classes.
Uses @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) in @variant selector and window.matchMedia for initial detection in service.
DarkModeToggleComponent with toggle() that cycles system -> dark -> light -> system.
DarkModeService uses signal<ColorSchemePreference>('system') for preference, computed() for isDark. Toggle component uses computed() for icon, label, ariaLabel.
